ApprovedTarget.description:
The operator-issued scope for one automation target. Existence of a matching,
unexpired, un-released scope is the owner's standing consent for that exact
(kind, target) pair; a worker can never mint one.

EvaluationReportInput.description:
The TS `EvaluationReport`, re-derivable and re-gated here. `state` and
`reasons` on the wire are ignored: the core re-derives them from the raw
counts before persisting anything.

RunResolution.description:
Resolution asserts only the expected run set, never authorizes a state
transition. Terminal run state must already be committed by C4.

oneOf.description: The operator's own adapter: the only caller that may open a scope.

A bounded coding worker: receives broker requests only, never the host
session bus or the operator's personal browser.

TargetKind.description:
A target kind the broker may scope authority over. `DocumentFile` is the
core-owned, byte-verified document model (the offline-qualifiable backend);
`BrowserProfile` and `NativeWindow` are live backends that require the
pinned AlphaCode executor.

WebGptTurnInput.description:
Input to a genuine WebGPT turn (W2). Image parts carry base64 inline data
(`data:<mime>;base64,<data>`); every image is stored in the run's project
CAS before the sidecar runs.

conversation_id.description:
Native conversation to continue, when the sidecar reports one. A turn
never opens a fresh chat implicitly: continuation only follows a
sidecar-confirmed conversation id, never a retry of a failed send.
